Do you want to do your part for society? Are you in favor of a cleaner world? Then come work as a driver's assistant at the Municipality (gemeente) of Alphen aan den Rijn. Naturally, you will be well rewarded for this. You earn €15.78 per hour, including allowances. Apply now for the position as driver's assistant!

What we offer
- Earn €15.78 per hour (incl. waste surcharge)
- A flexible job!
- A good work-life balance
- Friendly colleagues you ride with
- Morning shifts. Evenings for yourself!
- Outdoors work!

Who you are
As a driver's assistant, you want to get started quickly. You enjoy working outdoors and being on the road! You are also:

- Not afraid of a little filth
- Available part-time in the morning shifts between 07:45 a.m. till 02:30 p.m.
- Available on Mondays and Fridays at least.
- You can handle a few raindrops, because well… it sometimes rains in the Netherlands!
- You speak English or Dutch

What will you do
Your shift starts at 7:45 a.m., but you arrive at the location just a little earlier. Time for a cup of coffee. It is checked if everyone is present, and then you get to work as a driver's assistant. Together with your colleagues, you climb onto the truck and ride along as a co-driver on the garbage truck. You ensure that the trash cans are emptied and put them back neatly. You don't do this alone! You work in small teams, which is nice and sociable! Almost break time, so off to the company.
During the break, you can grab a snack in the canteen and then work for a few more hours. You can then go home between 02:30 p.m. and 03:30p.m.! Wonderful, time to unwind from your day and enjoy the evening :)

Where will you work
As a driver's assistant, you will work in various towns in the area surrounding the Municipality of Alphen a/d Rijn. You can also work in other departments. As a Validation Engineer, you will work in an innovative Research & Development environment focused on the development and validation of advanced automotive technologies. You will become part of the System Application & Validation team and be responsible for developing, executing and reporting validation tests at both IC and system level. You will work at the intersection of hardware, software and system validation, ensuring that new products and updates meet the defined requirements before they are released to customers. You will also have the opportunity to improve existing test methods and make validation processes smarter, more efficient and more reliable. Develop and execute test cases to fully validate IC- and system-level requirements; Develop and optimize validation setups at both IC and application level; Translate manual laboratory tests into reliable, repeatable and efficient automated test environments; Support the execution of system tests and analyze test results; Report on validation progress, results and technical issues; Define and document validation use cases and accurately record test results in project documentation and databases; Work closely with hardware and firmware developers, system architects and other validation teams; Actively contribute to improving validation processes, test methods and tooling. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A challenging assignment within an innovative and international R&D environment; A competitive salary based on your experience and knowledge; The opportunity to work on innovative technology within the automotive and semiconductor industries; A technically diverse environment where hardware, software and system development come together. Functie-eisen A completed Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a comparable technical discipline; At least 5 years of relevant work experience; Experience in the automotive and/or semiconductor industry, preferably with system-level validation; A broad interest in

electronics, software development and product validation; Experience with software development and a good understanding of the Software Engineering and Systems Development Lifecycle; Strong programming skills in, for example, Python, C, C++, LabVIEW and/or TestStand; Strong analytical skills and the ability to investigate complex technical issues in a structured manner; Good command of the English language, both verbally and in writing. Hier kom je te werken You will be working within an international Research & Development organization that develops innovative technologies for the automotive market. The organization works on technologies including infotainment, radio and amplifier systems, radar and Car2X solutions. As part of the System Application & Validation team, you will contribute to various projects related to automotive infotainment and digital radio technologies. The team brings hardware and firmware together and ensures that systems perform reliably before products are released to customers. You will work in a multidisciplinary environment and collaborate closely with marketing, system architects, hardware and firmware developers, and other validation teams. This gives you the opportunity to be involved throughout the development process, from initial development through validation and final release. Are you an experienced Validation Engineer looking to apply your expertise in a technically challenging R&D environment? Then we would be happy to get in touch with you!

You will work in shifts with the following hours:
Day shift: 1:00 PM – 9:30 PM
Night shift: 9:30 PM – 6:00 AM

Job application

All this with a starting hourly wage of €17! 😱🤑

- Fee of 35%, 50% or 100% for evening and weekends
- Travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometer
- 5-shift schedule, always have 4 days off
- Plenty of colleagues around during the day

Who you are
As a shuttle driver, you naturally possess the following:

- Willingness to work a 5-shift schedule: 2 morning shifts, 2 evening shifts, 2 night shifts, followed by 4 days off!

- Proficiency in Dutch or English

What will you do
You’ll be trained by an experienced driver. 🚛 You’ll get to know the distribution center step by step; there are nine locations you’ll be shuttling between—for instance, driving from Hall A to B or from D to F. You act as a vital link connecting all the halls. It’s busier during the day, so you’ll be moving from one task to the next, whereas at night, you might even have time to lend a hand in the warehouse. That makes for a really varied job, doesn't it? 💪🏼

Where will you work
The friendly company you’ll be working for is Kuehne+Nagel, a global transport and logistics firm.
